lists.sub.all: Everything in your vault and in the spaces you belong to.
lists.sub.login: Usernames and passwords for websites and apps.
lists.sub.note: Free text, kept encrypted like everything else.
lists.sub.file: Documents, photos and other files, encrypted before upload.
lists.sub.otp: Codes for two-step sign-in, made right here.
lists.sub.backupCodes: One-time codes that get you in when you lose your second step.
lists.sub.card: Payment cards, with number, expiry and security code.
lists.sub.identity: Passports, licenses and other ID documents.
lists.sub.contact: People and how to reach them.
lists.sub.sshKey: Keys for signing in to servers.
lists.sub.pgpKey: Keys for encrypting and signing email and files.
lists.enc.body: Every item is encrypted on your devices first, with ML-KEM-1024 and X25519, then AES-256-GCM. The server keeps ciphertext only and can't open any of it.
lists.vault.label: Vault
lists.trash.vaultNone.title: Nothing deleted from this vault
lists.trash.vaultNone.body: Items deleted from other vaults are still in the Trash. Pick All vaults to see them.
lists.details.codes: {total, plural, one {# code} other {# codes}}, {unused} unused
lists.details.subkeys: {count, plural, =0 {no subkeys} one {# subkey} other {# subkeys}}
manifest.notice.title: What the server holds doesn't match what your devices signed
manifest.notice.manifestRolledBack: The server sent an older signed list of items than this browser has already seen.
manifest.notice.manifestInvalid: A signed list of items the server sent could not be verified.
manifest.notice.manifestDropped: The server has no signed list of items, though this browser has seen one.
manifest.notice.rolledBack: {count, plural, one {# item is older than your devices last saw it.} other {# items are older than your devices last saw them.}}
manifest.notice.missing: {count, plural, one {# item your devices saw is missing.} other {# items your devices saw are missing.}}
manifest.notice.resurrected: {count, plural, one {# deleted item came back.} other {# deleted items came back.}}
manifest.notice.deleted: {count, plural, one {# item was deleted without a signature: by an app that can't sign, or by the server, and that can not be told apart from here.} other {# items were deleted without a signature: by an app that can't sign, or by the server, and that can not be told apart from here.}}
manifest.notice.implausible: {count, plural, one {# item has a revision it could not have reached.} other {# items have a revision they could not have reached.}}
manifest.notice.forged: {count, plural, one {# change to an item carries a signature that is not its writer's, and was not taken in.} other {# changes to items carry signatures that are not their writers', and were not taken in.}}
manifest.notice.unsigned: {count, plural, one {# change to an item has no signature, though this vault's changes are signed, and was not taken in.} other {# changes to items have no signature, though this vault's changes are signed, and were not taken in.}}
manifest.notice.publishFailed: This browser could not save the signed list of your items after your last change, so a rolled-back or hidden item may go unseen until it can.
manifest.notice.hint: Treat this as unreliable until you have checked it on another device that is signed in. It can be a fault on the server, or someone tampering with it: tell your administrator.
